verdict.rationale: USPTO has real machine surfaces: api.uspto.gov answers with a structured API-key auth challenge, a developer portal exists, and Patent Center docs mention direct API calls to Workbench/view-application surfaces. However, the evidence documents the core UI workflows only as interactive web flows: trademark and patent filing, fee payment, assignments, extensions, and Statements of Use run through Trademark Center, TEAS, Patent Center and Financial Manager, behind an MFA and identity-verified account. Nothing shows these actions are exposed via API, and the OpenAPI probe and llms.txt both 404. Missing for 10: API coverage of filing/submission workflows, API-based fee payment, API access to trademark actions (extensions, amendments, SOU), an OpenAPI spec or readable API docs, and independent confirmation of UI–API parity.
